summary: Collabora Online Development Edition (CODE) provides a web-based office suite for editing word documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. Built on LibreOffice, it allows you to host your own collaborative document editing infrastructure on private servers.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want to integrate browser-based document editing capabilities into their existing private cloud storage or infrastructure.
watchOut: Document editing suites typically impose significant memory and CPU overhead under load, and this development edition lacks clear metrics on recent maintenance or tagged releases.
deployNotes: As a C++ application handling browser communication, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy configured for TLS and allocate persistent storage for user documents.
